notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer support chat) evaluating Hosted API for initial roll-out; want ability to move to Dedicated once throughput and residency needs are formalized. Streaming + tool-calling are critical. First-token SLO target is <1.5s (90th percentile) for US-based users.

Discovery highlights:
- Product team (PM + Eng) cares about consistent streaming latency for agent UI and low tail latency when tool calls invoked (CRM lookup, ticket creation).
- Architecture: frontend web chat -> Redwood Hosted API -> middleware for tool calling (Zendesk / internal CRM). Interested in Redwood function/tool-calling or streaming hooks.
- Preference: start on Hosted API to accelerate POC. If Hosted meets latency SLO under 10k concurrent tokens/day, will evaluate Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and VPC requirement.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, SOC2 or equivalent required by procurement, customer wants audit logs and KMS integration for dedicated. US-only data residency requirement.
- Cost sensitivity: careful on token egress; wants model/quantization guidance and batching recommendations.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need the agent UI to feel instant — first-token under 1.5s is non-negotiable for launch." — Head of Product
- "Tool calling must not add >200ms median overhead on top of model latency." — Lead Backend Engineer

POC notes:
- We ran a 2-week POC using Hosted API (live traffic replay) with sample traffic generator provided by Redwood.
- Measured first-token: 90th pctl = 1.28s for streaming path in us-west region during off-peak; peaks pushed to ~1.6s under synthetic concurrency.
- Tool-calling flow (Zendesk lookup + ticket create) added median 120ms when using Redwood streaming + middleware callback.
- Observability: Redwood Console traces and token-level cost breakdown very helpful for tuning.

Decision signals:
- Will purchase Hosted with a 6-month runway if Redwood can guarantee <1.5s 90p for typical traffic and provide a playbook for Dedicated transition.
- Procurement needs SOC2 evidence and signed DPA before Dedicated procurement review.

Next steps owned by Redwood AE / SE:
- Provide Dedicated sizing and committed pricing examples (Marcus/ Priya).
- Share k6 script used in POC and annotated latency report.
- Set up security deep-dive w/ RelayPulse security team (requested week of 2026-03-15).
- Follow-up demo to show automatic batching/caching recommendations and rollouts for canary traffic.
